title: Bloodthirst rockslug
support: The '''bloodthirst'''{{Sic}} '''rockslug''' was an unused variant of the [[giant rockslug]], the [[superior]] variant of the [[rockslug]], that would have appeared after unlocking the [[Bloodthirsty]] [[Trailblazer Reloaded League/Relics|relic]] in [[Trailblazer Reloaded League]]. Because rockslugs could not be assigned as a Slayer task during the league, it was never possible to encounter a bloodthirst rockslug.
